# UserStatusHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.UserStatusHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The UserStatus handler class. Used to handle user status updates (user going online or offline).
It is intended to be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the [`on_user_status`](../decorators/on_user_status.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when a new user status update arrives. It takes *(client, user)*
  as positional arguments (look at the section below for a detailed description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of users to be passed in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the user status handler.

    user ([`User`](../types/user_and_chats/User.md)):
        The user containing the updated status.

_Source: `pyrogram/handlers/user_status_handler.py`._
